title: Table 3.3b Reduced primary street setback

rows.note: no row in Table 3.3b for R50 and above

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 2 - Single Houses.pdf

notes: Reduced primary street setback column only. The 'maximum percentage of frontage width' column is the same for every code (the greater of 30% of the frontage width or 4 m) and is encoded as a formula in C3.3.2(i)-r1. Footnote: maximum percentage of frontage width excludes garages provided in accordance with Table 3.3c.
